paths.name: Path of Da' Savage
paths.description: A mastery path focused on longer-duration battles

ability.name: Wot Rules?
ability.description: Exhaustive Blows will no longer remove your Rage, but being Furious no longer grants Exhaustive Blows any additional effects.

ability.name: Tired Already?
ability.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 50 Rage
ability.description:
You chop your target in a vital organ, dealing 216 damage. For the next 10 seconds, any abilities that they use will take an additional 5 seconds to cooldown.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

ability.name: Yer Gettin' Soft
ability.description: When your attacks get defended, increases your chance to critically hit with Path of Da' Savage abilities by 100% for the next 3 seconds.

ability.name: No More Helpin'
ability.description: You chop at your enemy, dealing 178 damage and reducing the value of incoming heals on them by 50% for the next 10 seconds.

ability.name: Red goes faster!
ability.description: While Berserk, hitting an enemy with a Path of Da' Savage ability reduces all your active cooldowns by 1 second.

ability.name: Furious Choppin'
ability.description: A merciless strike of attacks that repeatedly hits your target for up to 5 seconds, dealing up to 269 damage. You will be healed for all damage this ability deals.

ability.name: We'z Fightin' Betta
ability.description: Your rage inspires all around, causing groupmates' attacks to deal an additional 300 damage for 10 seconds while within 100 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Don't Go Nowhere
coreAbilities.description: A maiming attack which deals 178 damage to the target and snares them, reducing their run speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Throat Slasha
coreAbilities.description: You slash at your opponent's throat, immediately inflicting 145 damage. The wound continues to bleed for 180 damage over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Go For Da Soft Spot
coreAbilities.note: Target must be facing away from you
coreAbilities.description: You deal 253 damage to your enemy.

coreAbilities.name: Bring Da Pain!
coreAbilities.description: Each time that you attack an enemy within the next 10 seconds, Any group member within 100 feet will have their Weapon Skill increased by 33, but your Toughness will also be reduced by 33 for the next 10 seconds. This effect can be stacked up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Try An' Hurt Me
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
An exhaustive blow that deals 178 damage and reduces your target's chance to critically hit by 100% for 10 seconds.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

paths.name: Path of Da' Hitta
paths.description: A mastery path focused on dealing quick exhaustive blows

ability.name: Long Lasta
ability.description: Your Exhaustive blows now exhaust 15 Rage less when used while Furious.

ability.name: Bleed Em Out
ability.description: Your target suffers 695 damage over 8 seconds. The damage is increased by 10% for every 10% health the target is missing. If wielding a Great Weapon: When the effect ends or the target dies while affected by this ability, you instantly gain 20 Rage.

ability.name: Wear Em Down
ability.description: Your Exhaustive Blows increase your autoattack damage by 25% for  5 seconds.

ability.name: Big Bad Combo
ability.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Berserk
Exhausts up to 35 Rage
ability.description: You unleash a frenzied combo of attacks, dealing 194 damage twice. Your chance to critically hit the target is increased by 10% for 10s. This effect stacks with other sources. Countin' is for stuntiez.

ability.name: Strong Finish
ability.description: Weakling Killa, Bleed Em Out and Big Bad Combo will almost always critically hit if the target's health is below 30%.

ability.name: Keep On Choppin'
ability.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 50 Rage
ability.description:
You chop deeply into your enemy, dealing 291 damage. Your love of battle fills you with energy, preventing your next Exhaustive attack within 10 seconds from expending any Rage.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

ability.name: Yer Goin Down!
ability.description: You savagely chop at all enemies within 25 feet, dealing 1200 damage and tearing up the enemies' flesh, reducing incoming healing by 50% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Slasha
coreAbilities.description: A furious slash that deals 216 damage and reduces your target's Toughness by 50 for 9 seconds. This effect is stackable up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Reckless Blow
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 35 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
A wild swing which deals 291 damage.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus and deal 337 damage to yourself.

coreAbilities.name: Weaklin' Killa
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Great Weapon
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
You unleash a powerful blow, dealing 441 damage. This ability exhausts 10% less Rage for each 10% health that the target is missing.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

coreAbilities.name: Hurtin' Time
coreAbilities.description: While this ability is active, your will deal an additional 150 damage  whenever you strike a target with a melee attack, but you will also suffer 75 damage each time this effect occurs.

coreAbilities.name: Sit Down!
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description: Deals 216 damage and knocks down the target for 3 seconds. The attack is undefendable.

paths.name: Path of Da' Wrecka
paths.description: A mastery path focused on area of effect offensive abilities

ability.name: Longer and Stronger
ability.description: While you are Furious, you regain 150 health every 4 seconds. While you are Berserk, you regain 262 health every 4 seconds.

ability.name: Wot's Da Rush?
ability.note:
Requires Dual Wield
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 50 Rage
ability.description:
You lash out at all enemies within 25 feet, inflicting 142 damage. All of the victims will also become snared, reducing their run speed by 30% for 5 seconds.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

ability.name: Extra Choppin'
ability.description: Lotsa Choppin' will now hit up to 24 targets within 30 feet in front of you, but its damage is reduced by 15%.

ability.name: Furious Stompin'
ability.description: You stomp the ground below, dealing 194 damage to all targets within 25 feet. For the following 6 seconds, you continue stomping the ground every 2 seconds dealing 130 damage to all targets within 25 feet. This ability is cancelled when you are no longer Berserk.

ability.name: Keep It Comin'
ability.description: When you die, Mork grants you a second chance, temporarily resurrecting you with 25% health and resetting all your cooldowns. If you manage to kill an enemy within 10 seconds, Mork lets you keep your new life. If not, you will die once again. You cannot be resurrected by this effect more than once every 60 seconds.

ability.name: Git To Da Choppa
ability.description: You frantically lash out at everything nearby for up to 6 seconds, dealing 207 damage every 2 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet. Each time you deal damage, you'll randomly pull one of the victims in towards you. Your speed is increased by 20% for as long as this ability is active.

ability.name: Stomp Da Yard
ability.description: You stomp the ground, knocking down targets within 25 feet for 3 seconds and dealing 1800 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Lotsa Choppin
coreAbilities.description: You wildly swing at enemies in front of you within 30 feet, dealing 165 damage. May only hit up to three targets.

coreAbilities.name: Wild Choppin'
coreAbilities.note:
Must be Furious or Berserk
Exhausts up to 100 Rage
coreAbilities.description:
You strike enemies within 25 feet, dealing  231 damage. You gain 5 Rage for each enemy hit, up to a maximum of 9 targets.

If you are Furious, gains a 75% damage bonus instead of the 25% bonus.

coreAbilities.name: Come and Git It!
coreAbilities.description: For the next 5 seconds, you cannot deal or receive critical damage.

coreAbilities.name: Yer All Bleedin' Now
coreAbilities.description: You swipe at the enemies in front of you, dealing 444 over 9 seconds to enemies within 40 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Bring It On
coreAbilities.description: For the next 5 seconds you strike out at all enemies 25 feet in front of you, inflicting 231 damage every second. While Berserk, Bring It On additionally deals 269 damage back to the attacker each time you are hit with an attack, this effect can only be triggered once every second.

coreAbilities.name: Bypass Defenses
coreAbilities.description: You bolster yourself for 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass the defenses of an enemy keep's postern door, porting you inside.

coreAbilities.name: Siege Wrecker
coreAbilities.description: You sabotage a siege ram, causing the ram to deal 98% of the original damage for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Faultfinder
coreAbilities.description: Increases friendly ram damage by 2% for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Fling Choppa
coreAbilities.description: A basic throwing attack that inflicts 82 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Charge!
coreAbilities.description: You charge into the thick of battle, increasing your movement speed by 50% for 7 seconds.  If you use any abilities, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Outta My Face!
coreAbilities.description: All enemies within 25 feet are detaunted, making them hate you less and reducing the damage they deal against you to 50% for 5 seconds.  During this time, all of your attacks will cause enemies to hate you 25% less than normal. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone you have detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Nerve
coreAbilities.description: A directed strike that inflicts 1200 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: I'm Da Biggest!
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Wounds by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Shrug It Off
coreAbilities.description: Any roots or snares are removed, as all attempts to impede your movement are futile. For the next 10 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Git Stuck In
coreAbilities.description: Your groupmates are inspired by your eagerness to fight. Auto attack speed is increased by 35% for 20 seconds for all groupmates within 100 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Force of Will
coreAbilities.description: You stare down your opponent, draining 200 of their Action Points into yourself, and reducing their Strength by 160 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Jagged Edge
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy they will begin to bleed, suffering additional 513 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Don't Wanna Live Foreva
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength and Weapon Skill by 120, but reduces your Toughness by 120.

coreAbilities.name: Drop Da Basha
coreAbilities.note: Requires Target to have Parried or Blocked
coreAbilities.description: Your attacks become more precise, your target's chance to block or parry is reduced by 50% for 10 seconds. This attack cannot be defended against.

coreAbilities.name: Brute Force
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Confusing Movements
coreAbilities.description: Concentrating on your perceived movements, you will be able to Dodge and Parry all attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Don't Bother Me None
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Spirit resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Assault
coreAbilities.description: A prolonged fervor that grants 10 Action Points a second to everyone in your group within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Finish 'Em Faster
coreAbilities.description: Cooldowns on your Exhaustive Blows are reduced by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Stab You Gooder
coreAbilities.description: All of your critical hits will deal 25% more bonus critical damage.

coreAbilities.name: Overpowering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You strike your opponent with surprising force, dealing 1200 damage and knocking them down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking
coreAbilities.description:
All of your attacks deal 15% more damage when you strike an enemy from the sides or rear.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Close Combat
coreAbilities.description: Any time you strike an enemy in melee with a direct attack, you will receive 25% less damage from ranged and magical attacks for 2 seconds. This effect will not guard or detaunt abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Bloodlust
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you exhaust Rage with an attack, you are healed for 15 health per point of Rage exhausted.

coreAbilities.name: Dat Tickles!
coreAbilities.description: Absorbs 3600 damage for up to 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an enemy's attack, you will strike them back for 253 damage which they can not prevent.

coreAbilities.name: Can't Stop Da Chop
coreAbilities.description: Your Exhaustive Abilities now remove one movement impairing effect from yourself. You gain 40 Action Points each time an effect is removed. This cannot happen more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tantrum
coreAbilities.description: For the next 30 seconds you deal an additional 300 damage, whenever you use an ability. This effect will fade after you damage 8 targets.

coreAbilities.name: Don't Hate Da Choppa
coreAbilities.description: All Taunts and Detaunts are 25% less effective against you.

coreAbilities.name: Easy Killin'
coreAbilities.description: Reduces the Action Point costs by 5 points in Furious state and 10 points in Berserk state.

coreAbilities.name: Supa Chop
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1800 damage and reduces Action Point costs by 50% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Chop Til You Drop
coreAbilities.description: Get Stuck In's cooldown timer is lowered by 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Was Dat Yer Finger?
coreAbilities.description: When you do critical damage, reduces your target's Weapon Skill by 120 for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities will cost 25% fewer action points, cool down 50% faster, and deal 20% more damage for 7 seconds.
